text.used_on_filled_buttons_and_the_announcem: Used on filled buttons and the announcement bar. Choose a readable contrast against Accent.
text.check_text_and_button_contrast_after_cha: Check text and button contrast after changing your palette.
text.off_keeps_elarune_s_original_georgia_and: Off keeps Elarune's original Georgia and Arial system fonts, with no font downloads. Turn on to apply the selections below.
text.system_fonts_need_no_download_check_all_: System fonts need no download. Check all store languages; unavailable characters use fallback fonts.
text.only_visible_inside_the_theme_editor_che: Only visible inside the theme editor. Checks section inputs; does not certify launch readiness.
text.share_permitted_customer_videos_or_produ: Share permitted customer videos or product demonstrations. Videos play only when a visitor chooses. Add captioned videos and a descriptive transcript for accessibility.
text.describe_this_video_so_visitors_can_dist: Describe this video so visitors can distinguish it from the other videos.
text.use_the_contributor_s_real_words_with_pe: Use the contributor's real words with permission. Do not add unsupported health claims.
text.use_only_the_name_or_credit_the_contribu: Use only the name or credit the contributor has agreed to publish.
text.include_speech_relevant_sounds_and_visua: Include speech, relevant sounds and visual information. Also provide captions in the uploaded video; a transcript does not replace synchronized captions.
text.use_matching_subject_lighting_and_framin: Use matching subject, lighting and framing. State the actual duration and product used.
text.explain_individual_variability_and_relev: Explain individual variability and relevant study conditions.
text.use_factual_details_about_your_products_: Use factual details about your products or brand.
text.choose_products_that_complement_your_ran: Choose products that complement your range. Suggestions appear in a non-empty cart. Products already in the cart and sold-out products are omitted. No discount or purchase-frequency claim is added.
text.up_to_four_eligible_products_are_shown_s: Up to four eligible products are shown. Simple products can be added directly; products with options, gift cards, required subscriptions or special quantity rules open their product page.
text.help_customers_complete_their_routine_pr: Help customers complete their routine. Product cards link to the product page so customers can choose the right options. This section does not claim purchase frequency or create bundle discounts.
text.for_shopify_recommendations_configure_co: For Shopify recommendations, configure complementary products in Search & Discovery. The products below remain available when recommendations cannot load or JavaScript is disabled.
text.choose_products_or_connect_a_product_lis: Choose products or connect a product-list metafield for suggestions specific to each product. Unavailable products and the current product are omitted.
text.add_your_own_liquid_or_html_use_an_app_b: Add your own Liquid or HTML. Use an app block when an app provides one.
text.optional_second_line_of_the_heading_d163: Optional second line of the heading.
text.uses_the_included_vector_signature_when_: Uses the included vector signature when no custom logo is selected.
text.use_this_only_when_your_free_shipping_ra: Use this only when your free shipping rate is based on the cart total after discounts and covers all physical products for that country. This indicator does not create a shipping rate. Check the amount in Shopify Settings → Shipping and delivery before switching it on.
text.leave_blank_to_use_your_store_s_shipping: Leave blank to use your store's shipping policy.
text.for_your_reference_in_the_editor_9fa929: For your reference in the editor.
text.two_letters_such_as_tr_de_or_us_add_one_: Two letters, such as TR, DE or US. Add one rule per country and currency.
text.three_letters_such_as_try_eur_or_usd_no_: Three letters, such as TRY, EUR or USD. No currency conversion is applied.
text.enter_the_full_amount_in_this_currency_w: Enter the full amount in this currency, without a currency symbol. No amount is supplied by the theme.
text.optional_details_such_as_the_delivery_se: Optional details, such as the delivery service or excluded regions. Use the shipping details link for the full policy.
text.use_a_factual_message_leave_blank_to_hid: Use a factual message. Leave blank to hide.
text.uses_the_included_vector_wordmark_when_n: Uses the included vector wordmark when no custom logo is selected.
text.add_actual_ingredient_names_licensed_ima: Add actual ingredient names, licensed images and descriptions supported by this product's formula. Empty blocks stay hidden on the storefront. The first illustrated card is featured when there are three or more ingredients.
text.only_use_supported_claims_relevant_to_th: Only use supported claims relevant to this product and concentration.
text.shown_when_the_bag_is_empty_and_no_custo: Shown when the bag is empty and no custom image is selected.
text.uses_the_collection_image_if_left_blank_: Uses the collection image if left blank.
text.configure_filters_in_shopify_search_disc: Configure filters in Shopify Search & Discovery.
text.add_your_actual_opening_hours_or_contact: Add your actual opening hours or contact information. Do not promise a response time you cannot meet.
text.appears_after_the_main_buy_button_scroll: Appears after the main buy button scrolls out of view. Uses the quantity and options in the product form.
text.shows_pickup_availability_preparation_ti: Shows pickup availability, preparation time and addresses from Shopify for the selected variant. Enable pickup in your shipping settings first. This block stays hidden when no pickup locations are returned.
text.configure_filters_in_shopify_search_disc: Configure filters in Shopify Search & Discovery. Shopify may omit filters for very large result sets.
text.availability_depends_on_shopify_s_suppor: Availability depends on Shopify's supported predictive search languages.
text.appears_before_searching_and_when_no_res: Appears before searching and when no results are found.
text.leave_blank_to_use_the_included_elarune_: Leave blank to use the included Elarune artwork.
text.a_curated_starting_point_before_searchin: A curated starting point before searching and when no results are found.
text.collect_email_marketing_signups_using_sh: Collect email marketing signups using Shopify. Configure confirmation emails and double opt-in in Shopify. Describe only the emails and offers you actually send.
text.use_a_licensed_still_life_or_campaign_im: Use a licensed still life or campaign image. Without an image, the signup stays centered.
text.optionally_link_your_privacy_policy_or_e: Optionally link your privacy policy or explain the content of your newsletter. Do not promise a discount that has not been configured.
text.choose_two_or_three_products_then_add_de: Choose two or three products, then add detail rows. Values always belong to the numbered product slot. Review them when replacing a product. Only use supported product information.
text.leave_blank_unless_backed_by_product_spe: Leave blank unless backed by product-specific evidence.
text.include_test_type_sample_size_duration_a: Include test type, sample size, duration and conditions as applicable.
text.help_customers_explore_alternatives_to_t: Help customers explore alternatives to this product. Product cards link to the product page so customers can choose the right options. This section does not claim purchase frequency or create bundle discounts.
text.for_shopify_recommendations_configure_re: For Shopify recommendations, configure related products in Search & Discovery. The products below remain available when recommendations cannot load or JavaScript is disabled.
text.add_milestones_in_the_order_customers_sh: Add milestones in the order customers should read them. Each needs a time label, title and description to appear. Use your own supported information; no results are supplied by the theme.
text.explain_who_the_information_applies_to_u: Explain who the information applies to, usage conditions and relevant limitations.
text.enter_the_actual_time_or_stage_supported: Enter the actual time or stage supported by your information.
text.describe_documented_observations_or_prod: Describe documented observations or product guidance. Do not promise unsupported results.
text.use_an_image_you_have_permission_to_publ: Use an image you have permission to publish and add descriptive alt text in the image settings.
text.for_results_include_the_source_method_da: For results, include the source, method, date, participants and relevant limits where applicable.
text.describe_the_actual_product_use_avoid_un: Describe the actual product use. Avoid unverified health claims.
text.show_real_product_option_swatches_and_co: Show real product option swatches and compare two side by side. Save color or image swatches on the product first. This is a visual guide, not a shade-match or virtual try-on tool. Product links let customers confirm all options before buying.
text.leave_blank_on_a_product_template_to_use: Leave blank on a product template to use its current product.
text.choose_the_position_of_your_shade_option: Choose the position of your shade option. Positions remain valid when option names are translated.
text.the_product_link_always_gives_access_to_: The product link always gives access to the complete selection.
text.connect_your_own_care_categories_to_real: Connect your own care categories to real collections. Labels describe your catalogue; this section does not diagnose skin conditions or generate product claims.
text.choose_the_collection_customers_should_r: Choose the collection customers should reach. The card stays hidden until a collection is selected.
text.leave_blank_to_use_the_collection_title_: Leave blank to use the collection title. Use a label supported by your product information.
text.optional_context_to_help_customers_choos: Optional context to help customers choose a collection.
text.customers_choose_products_and_variants_t: Customers choose products and variants, then add one of each selected variant. Without JavaScript, products can be added individually. No bundle discount is created. Products with more than 50 variants, purchase plans, bundles, gift cards or special quantity rules open their product page.

stories.name: Customer experiences
stories.permission: Only publish genuine feedback with permission. Leave the rating at 0 to hide stars. This form collects feedback; it does not publish reviews automatically.
stories.author: Customer name

campaign.name: Campaign invitation
campaign.help: Change the identifier to start a new campaign.
campaign.heading: Heading
campaign.label: Button label

vanity.name: Beauty vanity
vanity.help: Add product alternatives to each step. Use transparent or white-background images; turn blending off for other photography. Write the sequence and product guidance for your own catalog.

ritual_builder.label_2: Match products to preferences with comma-separated option values. Empty fields match every answer. The most specific matching product wins; earlier blocks break ties. Keep a general product per step as a fallback. Review all product suitability and claims before publishing.

ritual_shelf.concern_help: Use product-supported concerns, separated by a middle dot. Avoid unverified efficacy or repair claims.

ingredient_spotlight.name: Ingredient Spotlight
ingredient_spotlight.help: Use only verified ingredient concentrations and supported benefits. Keep the illustrative label enabled for concept/demo content; this section is not evidence of a product formula.

skin_timeline.name: Skin Timeline
skin_timeline.heading: Heading
skin_timeline.help: Add your own days, photographs and substantiated claims. Record the source, study conditions and limitations in Evidence. Demo photos are editorial illustrations, not before/after evidence. Disable the illustrative label only for verified content.
skin_timeline.metric_help: Comma separated. Enter only figures you can substantiate.

newsletter.show_sample_image_info: Displays a bundled sample still life until you upload your own image.

scheme.intro: Color schemes set the background, text, accent and border colors of sections. The first scheme is also used for the page, header, footer and product pages.

rich_text.name: Rich text
rich_text.heading_info: Italicize words to add an accent.

collapsible.name: Collapsible content
collapsible.faq_schema_info: Creates FAQPage structured data from the rows in this section. Use it only for questions and answers shown on this page.
collapsible.page_info: When a page is selected, its content replaces the row content.

consent.name: Cookie consent banner
consent.info: Shows only to visitors whose region requires consent, based on Shopify customer privacy settings. Turn off Shopify's own cookie banner so visitors see only one.
consent.privacy_link_info: Uses the privacy policy set in Settings > Policies.

collection_paging.style_info: Load more and infinite scroll keep a visible button and page links for keyboard and no-JavaScript visitors.

slideshow.name: Slideshow
slideshow.autoplay_info: Rotation pauses on hover, on keyboard focus and when reduced motion is preferred.
slideshow.show_arrows_info: Arrows stay visible when slide indicators are hidden, so every slide remains reachable.
slideshow.accessible_label_info: Describes the slideshow for screen reader users.
slideshow.mobile_image_info: Optional. Shown on screens narrower than 750 px.
slideshow.position_info: Start and end follow the reading direction of the store language.

image_with_text.name: Image with text
image_with_text.image_2_info: Optional detail image layered over a corner of the main image.
image_with_text.caption: Caption

video_section.name: Video
video_section.video_url_info: The player loads only after a visitor presses play. No third-party requests are made before that.
video_section.video_title_info: Describes the video for screen readers. Leave empty to use the heading.
video_section.poster_info: Shown before playback. Recommended for YouTube and Vimeo videos.
video_section.autoplay_info: Shopify-hosted video only. A pause button is always shown, and the video stays paused for visitors who prefer reduced motion.
video_section.overlay_opacity_info: Softens the video behind text in the background layout.

logo_list.name: Logo list
logo_list.layout_info: Quote tabs show logos that have a quote. The marquee becomes a static row for visitors who prefer reduced motion.
logo_list.name_info: Used as alt text, and shown as a wordmark when no image is set.
logo_list.quote_info: Shown in the quote tabs layout. Use only quotes you have permission to publish.

countdown.name: Countdown banner
countdown.end_date_info: Use the format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-12-31. Visitors see nothing until a valid date is set.
countdown.end_time_info: Use 24-hour HH:MM. Leave empty for midnight.
countdown.timezone_info: The UTC offset in effect at the end time, including daylight saving time.
countdown.ended_message_info: Leave empty to use the default message.
countdown.image_info: Used by the Image and timer and Full image layouts.
countdown.overlay_opacity_info: Applies to the Full image layout.

volume_pricing.show_discount_labels_info: Only enable when a matching automatic discount is set up in Shopify Discounts.

inventory.show_batch_badge_info: Shows the value of the custom.batch product metafield. Hidden when the metafield is empty.

newsletter.show_placeholder_image_info: Shows a placeholder illustration until you upload your own image.

search.discovery_image_info: The artwork area appears only when an image is selected.
